name: file-manager
description: Standardize dataset downloads, post-processing, and scoped analysis inside a user-specified data directory.

interface.shortDescription: Normalize raw, processed, and analysis files
interface.longDescription: Keep downloaded datasets, processing workflows, and user-scoped analyses in a normalized data tree for single- or multi-dataset model-development work.
defaultPrompt: Download this dataset into the specified data directory, then process it as requested.
Prepare separate raw and processed workflows for multiple datasets in this data directory.
Analyze this managed dataset in a user-named data_analysis subdirectory.
